sources: https://awesome.ecosyste.ms/api/v1/projects (GitHub topic keyword search over projects listed in awesome lists: boilerplate, template, starter, starter-kit, saas-boilerplate, project-template, cookiecutter, cookiecutter-template, github-template, template-repository, create-app, scaffold, cargo-generate, copier-template, giter8 and ~150 framework/language-specific template topics)

Curated awesome lists (boilerplate/template/starter sections), including EinGuterWaran/awesome-opensource-boilerplates, artemnovichkov/awesome-github-templates and melvin0008/awesome-projects-boilerplates
https://repos.ecosyste.ms/api/v1 (stars, license, archived, fork, is_template, pushed_at, topics)
https://azuresearch-usnc.nuget.org/query?packageType=Template and the .nupkg template.json (dotnet new packs and short names)
PyPI, RubyGems, Hex, Packagist, pub.dev, crates.io, proxy.golang.org and Maven Central (framework generators)
ranking.method: One rank over the whole list by GitHub stars of the source repository (for CLIs, generators and dotnet packs: the repository that publishes them, which can be a framework monorepo). Records without a resolvable GitHub repository follow, ordered by registry downloads. Directories (curated lists) are unranked. Skipped: forks, archived repositories and repositories with no push since 2023-10-10 (owner-requested entries are kept and flagged archived/stale), deprecated or stale packages, duplicates, and repositories that do not describe themselves as a template, boilerplate, starter, skeleton or scaffold. kind github-template means a repository starter copied with degit at a pinned commit; templateRepository: true marks repositories GitHub flags as template repositories (gh repo create --template line added). Stars and downloads were read on 2026-10-10.

review: Templates copy third-party code into a new project: read the license and pin the commit.
